      • loreOrEmpty

        @Nonnull
public static java.util.List<java.lang.String> loreOrEmpty(@Nullable
                                                                    org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta meta)
        Implementation Note:
        Slimefun core no longer bakes lore onto fresh item templates (name/lore are resolved per viewer at render time), so ItemMeta.getLore() returns null instead of an empty list until something explicitly adds a line.

      • mutableLoreOf

        @Nonnull
public static java.util.List<java.lang.String> mutableLoreOf(@Nullable
                                                                      org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta meta)
        A mutable lore list to append to: the item's current lore, or a fresh empty list if it has none.
        Implementation Note:
        See loreOrEmpty(ItemMeta); unlike that method this returns a modifiable list since callers here are about to add lines to it.

      • setLoreLine

        public static void setLoreLine(@Nonnull
                               org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta meta,
                               int index,
                               @Nonnull
                               java.lang.String line)
        Sets a single lore line at index and persists it onto meta, padding with blank lines first if the item has fewer lines than index.
        Implementation Note:
        Since core no longer bakes a lore skeleton onto fresh item templates, index may not exist yet where an addon's item used to always ship with it pre-filled.
